attribution: Original synthetic fixtures by Fieldkin contributors
fixture_policy: Twelve manually specified families; no transformations; concepts and rationales never enter matching. No Stage 1 held-out family is scored.
baseline_precision_anchors: For each corpus and assignment mode, additionally compare every model at the default precision of no_cardinality (original combined) and name_only. Derive those floors from their prespecified .70 operating points; select all models with the same threshold-grid rule. This is a development comparison, not threshold tuning for the library default.
selection_rule: For each fixed precision target choose the highest micro recall among grid thresholds meeting precision with at least one proposal; then greater precision; then higher threshold. Report no_feasible_threshold when none qualifies. Development-only operating points, not calibrated probabilities or validation estimates.
matched_precision_rule: For each candidate default operating point, select the baseline grid point with maximum recall subject to precision at least candidate precision and at least one proposal. Report no_feasible_threshold, never interpolate or imply dominance when baseline is infeasible.
distinct_reliability: Legacy overlap times lower non-null coverage times min(max(lower distinct count - 1, 0) / 2, 1). Distinctness 1 gives zero, 2 gives one-half, 3 or more gives full cardinality factor.
profile_definition: Runtime-kind histogram intersection; text additionally uses character-length bins 0, 1-4, 5-12, 13-32, 33+. Multiply by lower non-null coverage, min(lower non-null count / 8, 1), and min(max(lower distinct count - 1, 0) / 7, 1).

ablation_definitions.combined: Current default distinct-aware sampled evidence; default aliases; explicit hints honored.
ablation_definitions.no_cardinality: Legacy overlap-only sample reliability, preserving .65/.20/.15 weights; aliases and hints unchanged. On the original development corpus this reproduces original combined matching scores.
ablation_definitions.name_only: Name weight 1; declared-type veto disabled; sample, profile and hints omitted.
ablation_definitions.profile: Add optional SampleProfileMatcher at .10, subtract .10 from names; other weights unchanged.
ablation_definitions.no_profile: Same .55/.20/.15/.10 weights as profile, but .10 returns missing evidence, without renormalizing.
ablation_definitions.no_aliases: Combined weights with an empty alias map.
ablation_definitions.no_hints: Combined weights with caller hints stripped; the original corpus has no hints so this is identical to combined there.

semantic_hint_policy: Optional caller-verified unit, currency and identifier_scope strings compare exactly and case-sensitively. Two supplied, unequal values veto a pair independently of weighted matchers. One missing side is unknown. Hints do not infer conversions and agreement adds no weighted score. Each label is at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.
numeric_policy: Integer samples retain signed 128-bit identity. Decimal samples retain a signed 128-bit coefficient and scale 0..38, canonicalizing trailing decimal zeroes. Integer, decimal and approximate Number samples are distinct representations and are not implicitly coerced into one another.
reporting: Separate original development and new extension totals; by-family results at default threshold; all threshold aggregate rows; fixed-precision and baseline-matched comparisons; integer counts and all Stage 1 metrics. No pooling across the two corpora.
tuning_policy: Protocol, fixtures and gold labels committed before any Stage 3 scoring. No holdout access. Targets may remain unmet and results do not establish real-world accuracy.
